CameraSourceMenu.selectAVehicleToConfigureIts: Select a vehicle to configure its camera feeds.
CameraSourceMenu.howTheGcsCommandsTheMount: How the GCS commands the mount. Auto/Manager use the MAVLink gimbal manager (ArduPilot 4.1+). Mount control uses DO_MOUNT_CONTROL for legacy mounts. RC-driven = flown from the transmitter (display only). Off hides the controls.
CameraSourceMenu.whichMountInstanceToCommand0: Which mount instance to command (0 = all gimbals, 1 = MNT1, 2 = MNT2).
CameraSourceMenu.horizontalFieldOfViewNeededFor: Horizontal field of view, needed for click-to-point accuracy
CameraSourceMenu.dongleArdudeckReceivesDirectlyWithThe: Dongle: STOHID receives directly with the plugged-in dongle. Network: a separate ground station forwards video to the udp url.
CameraSourceMenu.codecTheCameraSendsWifilink2: Codec the camera sends. WiFiLink 2 defaults to H.265.
CameraSourceMenu.convertToH264SoThe: Convert to H.264 so the stream can render (required for H.265; costs some CPU)
CameraSourceMenu.rtspTransportAutoNegotiatesUdpThen: RTSP transport: Auto negotiates UDP then falls back to TCP. UDP = lowest latency on a clean LAN; TCP = reliable through firewalls / lossy links.
CameraSourceMenu.lowLatencySmallJitterBufferDrop: Low-latency: small jitter buffer, drop late frames
CameraSourceMenu.cameraControlTip: Day/night, IR and white light through the camera's own web API
CameraSourceMenu.cameraHostTip: Camera web address; empty = the address from the RTSP link
CameraSourceMenu.httpPort: HTTP port of the camera web interface (80 by default)
CameraSourceMenu.cameraChannel: Camera channel (1 for a single camera)
CameraSourceMenu.mirrorTip: Show the picture mirrored left-right, like a rear-view mirror
CameraSourceMenu.rotate180Tip: For a camera mounted upside down

camera_presets.autoDiscoversTheStreamUriFrom: Auto-discovers the stream URI from VIDEO_STREAM_INFORMATION. Falls back to manual if the vehicle never advertises one.
camera_presets.cameraAutopilotMustShareThe192: Camera + autopilot must share the 192.168.144.x subnet. Set the IP in SIYI Assistant.
camera_presets.wifiHotspotModeUsbTetherUses: WiFi hotspot mode. USB-tether uses 192.168.42.129; station mode uses the assigned IP.
camera_presets.enableVideoForwardingToLocalNetwork: Enable "video forwarding to local network" in RubyFPV. The engine bridges its raw H.264/UDP into the hub.
camera_presets.anyRtspSourceTheHubRepublishes: Any RTSP source. The hub republishes it as low-latency WebRTC.
camera_presets.tickStreamFpvToArdudeckIn: Tick "Stream FPV to STOHID" in the simulator launcher. Swap in the simulator machine's address if it runs elsewhere. Port 8654 is the simulator's own media hub, kept clear of this one's 8554.
camera_presets.rawH264OverUdpE: Raw H.264 over UDP, e.g. a companion-computer GStreamer pipeline.
camera_presets.higherLatencyThanRtpButResilient: Higher latency than RTP but resilient over lossy long-haul links.
camera_presets.aWhepEndpointPublishedByA: A WHEP endpoint published by a companion computer. Lowest latency, played directly.
camera_presets.analogFpvToUsbDongleOr: Analog-FPV-to-USB dongle or capture card on this machine. Played locally: the only path suitable for piloting.
